name: cleaver
title: Cleaver
description: A butcher's counter: every product is a white ticket on a steel spike, its price in fat ox-blood slab numerals over the name in black capitals, in rows in a steel tray on white glazed tiles, with a navy apron stripe under the shop's name.

tokens.--font-slab: the slab-serif face of the price numerals, the shop's name and the phone number
tokens.--font-grot: the plain grotesque of everything else: product names in capitals, labels, body text
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capital labels: menu, categories, status, card headings
tokens.--price-size: largest size of the price numerals on a ticket; the product page scales it up
tokens.--color-bg: page background: the face of the wall tiles, and the masthead
tokens.--color-grout: the grout lines between the wall tiles
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings and the shop's name
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dates, the footer, the word beside the phone number
tokens.--color-accent: links, the current menu item, list bullets and focus rings
tokens.--color-paper: the sheets that carry page text and product details
tokens.--color-line: thin rules: sheet edges, table and list rules, the line above the footer
tokens.--color-tray: the steel tray the tickets lie in
tokens.--color-tray-rim: the steel edge of the tray and the crease inside its rim
tokens.--color-tray-lip: the bright lip of the rolled rim, just inside the edge
tokens.--color-ticket: the ticket card, and the phone and e-mail cards on the apron (light in both schemes)
tokens.--color-ticket-ink: product names and the rule above them on a ticket
tokens.--color-ticket-muted: category, unit and description on a ticket
tokens.--color-price: the price numerals on a ticket and the phone number on the apron
tokens.--color-soldout: the card of a sold-out ticket
tokens.--color-soldout-ink: everything printed on a sold-out ticket
tokens.--color-spike: the steel spike under each ticket
tokens.--color-apron: the apron: the stripe under the masthead and the how-to-order card
tokens.--color-apron-stripe: the narrow stripes in the apron stripe
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--shadow-ticket: the shadow that lifts a ticket off the tray
tokens.--grout: width of the grout lines and of the line above the footer
tokens.--stripe: height of the apron stripe; its stripe widths follow in proportion
tokens.--spike: length of the spike under a ticket, and so the gap between rows of tickets
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of tickets, the apron card and code; the tray is rounded three times as much
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a label and its value
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside tickets, between tickets side by side
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens and the padding of cards
tokens.--space-5: large gap above the how-to-order card
